clips.author: nemi
clips.text: I drew this place, and that eraser is eating the floor. I'm on that floor. Click and drag to look around, or swipe on your phone. Find the door to your left or the tear to your right, then press one for the door, or two for the tear.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: On phones, tap the matching chapter. You can pause to look.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: Oh, of course. It's a drawing of a door. I gave it a doorknob and absolutely no depth.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: The little keyhole was ambitious. Let's put that back. Try two for the tear; I can be embarrassed somewhere with an actual opening.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: That eraser is still coming. Keep going.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: Wait, there's actual space behind the paper. We can get through that! My best exit is the bit I didn't draw.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: And there's my real desk beyond it. Once I'm on that desk, I'm outside the drawing, where the eraser can't reach me. But there's a gap before I get there.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: Oh. I stopped drawing the bridge halfway across. Apparently I thought Future Me would deal with it. Look underneath the left route, then at that loose paper tab on the right. Four to run across, or five to fold the tab.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: I was going to take a very confident first step. The bridge has taken it for me. Right into the hole. That's useful information to get before the rest of me follows. Back it up. Five for the paper tab, please.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: We still need that desk. The eraser hasn't stopped, and neither can we.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: There, that fold reaches the other side, and the crease is holding. Okay, small steps. I'm trusting paper with my entire existence, which feels like a fairly normal day in animation. There, both feet are across. I think I'm allowed to breathe now.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: Look to our right. It's the same eraser, still heading toward my desk and wiping out the ink path. The ground won't last much longer. But that solid top isn't made of ink, so we could use it as a lift. Seven to race it, or eight to ride it straight onto that desk.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: I had a whole escape route a second ago. Now it's a very clean drawing of absolutely nothing. Excellent work, eraser. Terrible timing. I'm staying right here until that bit comes back. Okay, eight. Let's use the thing that's already going there.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: Okay, I'm on. This is a ridiculous vehicle, but it does have a better route than I do. Just keep going toward the desk. No sudden turns. I am being surprisingly polite to something that nearly deleted my shoes. There's the edge. Ready?

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: Straight onto the desk. Then we're off the page.

clips.author: nemi
clips.text: A desk. A boring, solid desk. I've never appreciated furniture this much. Thank you for getting me out of that. I'm going to fix the drawing now, starting with a proper exit. Actually, no. First, that eraser is staying out here.
